label: Campaign launch
description: A brand launches or announces a new campaign.

label: New marketing leader
description: New CMO, VP Marketing, Brand Director or VP Brand appointed.

label: Agency review or search
description: A brand puts creative business up for review, or a consultant announces a search.

label: Product launch or expansion
description: New product, new market or retail expansion.

label: Investment
description: New funding or acquisition of a consumer brand.

label: Client win or scope increase
description: An agency wins a consumer client or expands scope.

label: Award or shortlist
description: Shortlisted or won at Cannes, Effies, One Show and similar.
tone_guidance: No pitch. Acknowledge the award only.

label: Layoffs or restructure
description: Handled gently. Opener is empathetic and never pitches.
tone_guidance: Only acknowledge the news kindly. No pitch or opportunity framing. Never raise relevance for layoffs.

label: Lost a major client or account
